title: DC-area forecast: A few evening showers. Light rain possible predawn into midday Sunday.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Late afternoon and evening temperatures hold in the 60s under mostly cloudy skies, with showers passing mainly south of the Beltway.

What's next? Light and sometimes steady showers and rain Sunday morning may linger into midday before tapering into more periodic showers for the afternoon. Crisp, sunny fall weather starts the workweek.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Occasional lingering showers should be mainly south of the Beltway through this evening, with more persistent rain near Fredericksburg and in Southern Maryland. Showers may try to move northward back into the Beltway area and north around or after midnight. Overnight lows in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Sunday): Scattered showers are possible across the region during the morning, then should focus south and east of DC in the afternoon, with cloudy skies and highs near 60 to the mid-60s. New rainfall totals could reach around 0.2 to 0.4 inches south and east of DC, while areas north and west may see very little to about 0.1 inch. Confidence: Low-Medium

Tomorrow night: Mostly cloudy skies stick around with a few lingering sprinkles or a shower possible into the evening, mainly east of DC. Drying out overnight as lows dip into the mid- to upper 50s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Clouds may linger into the morning on Monday, but skies should eventually turn mostly sunny, as highs reach the upper 60s to low 70s. It starts to feel more like fall with drier air (dew points in the mid-50s). Winds turn a bit breezy from the northwest, around 10 to 15 mph with occasional higher gusts. Monday night lows cool down into the 40s. Confidence: Medium

Plenty of sunshine and that fall feel continue through midweek. Highs reach the low to mid-60s on Tuesday before climbing to the mid- to upper 60s on Wednesday. Light winds around 5 to 10 mph both days. Overnight lows mainly in the 40s, with some 30s possible in typical cold spots north and west. Confidence: Medium-High

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Not exactly the nice fall weather we would like to start the weekend, but some areas should see showers wane by afternoon. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

DC weather history for October 3

A torrential 1927 storm ended a late-season heat wave, dumping record rain and unleashing damaging winds that flooded streets and disrupted services across the city.
